supported.guidance: Install into ~/.claude/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise the default global directory.

supported.guidance: Switch/Web display this client as ChatGPT; the native host ID remains codex. Install into ~/.agents/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use the documented default unless the user explicitly supplies an absolute target.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.workbuddy/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: WORKBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR/skills, then CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise the default.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.gemini/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use ~/.agents/skills when an official Skill already exists there, because Gemini discovers it before ~/.gemini/skills; report lower-priority managed duplicates without deleting them.

supported.guidance: Install into ~/.grok/skills. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use the documented default unless the user explicitly supplies an absolute target.

supported.guidance: Install into the selected OpenCode config root. The native executor has credential-format fixture coverage; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance is separate.
supported.directorySelection: OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode/skills, default ~/.config/opencode/skills. Overrides must be absolute without parent traversal. Doctor checks the loaded root, selected/global roots and documented ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills compatibility roots, without scanning projects or deleting duplicates.

supported.guidance: Read-only adapter for the saved Switch-managed TRAE connection on local macOS/Windows, included in 0.19.6. Verify the active receipt and its exact account-scoped model caches; multiple editions, distinct saved credentials, missing or edited records stop. Actual Skill loading, API and delivery acceptance remain pending. No claim of current chat selection.
supported.directorySelection: International ~/.trae/skills; domestic ~/.trae-cn/skills. Select the sole existing edition root; with both present require an explicit absolute target. No migration or duplicate deletion.

supported.guidance: Claude Desktop local Code sessions load Claude Code skills. Read only the active Desktop 3P connection, never Claude Code credentials. Mapped-mode Skills support shipped in 1.0.0 and requires the Switch-applied same-host companion bound to the managed profile hash; its local chat token is never a public API credential. Async media requires a connection-bound task record. Cloud/Cowork, Windows ACL and native delivery acceptance remain separate.
supported.directorySelection: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/skills when explicitly configured; otherwise ~/.claude/skills. Shared with Claude Code; select --host claude-desktop for Desktop 3P authentication.

supported.guidance: Install into the local DSH Harness skills directory. On Windows use %APPDATA%/dsh-desktop/harness/skills. Credential fixtures cover the selected provider and its versioned refs or strictly validated legacy flat store; real-host API and delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: DSH_HOME/skills when explicitly supplied by the local Harness; otherwise the desktop application-data harness/skills directory. Project/custom roots may shadow it; doctor reports the documented shared Agents root.

supported.guidance: Distributed adapter for official DeepSeek Harness default local Desktop composition only; distinct from community DSH Desktop. Switch Cordis patch and versioned refs are fixture-tested. Overrides stop. Actual host loading, dedicated API and native delivery acceptance pending.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute DSH_HOME/skills, otherwise ~/.dsh/skills. Project/custom roots may shadow it. CLI, custom composition, remote and session overrides are unsupported.

supported.guidance: Distributed adapter for MiniMax Code Desktop 3.1.0 local default conversations only. Uses the exact saved default custom provider/model, independent of sibling protocol providers. CLI/profile/session overrides are unsupported; real host loading, API and delivery acceptance pending.
supported.directorySelection: MINIMAX_DATA_DIR/skills, then MAVIS_DATA_DIR/skills, otherwise ~/.minimax/skills only when no Desktop preferences select another root. A standalone installer with a Desktop preferences store requires a confirmed absolute target; it never guesses the saved data directory. The executor resolves only declared macOS/Windows preference files; legacy migration belongs to MiniMax.

supported.guidance: Local ZCode execution only. Resolve one unique enabled Pure Tokens connection; this does not identify the current conversation model. Real-host API and native delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: ZCODE_DATA_BASE_DIR/.zcode/skills when explicitly configured with an absolute base directory; otherwise ~/.zcode/skills. Remote workspace synchronization does not supply the executor or connection.

supported.guidance: Native executor credential-format fixtures; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: KIMI_CODE_HOME/skills or default.

supported.guidance: Native executor credential-format fixtures; actual host API and attachment delivery acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: QODER_CONFIG_DIR/skills; otherwise QODER_CLI_HOME or home plus QODER_CONFIG_DIR_NAME (default .qoder), then skills.

supported.guidance: Local Pi only. Verify one matching models.json endpoint before checking the same provider ID in sibling auth.json. Supported inline auth takes precedence; dynamic or unrepresented authentication stops without fallback. Real-host API and attachment delivery remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/skills when explicitly configured with an absolute root without parent traversal; otherwise ~/.pi/agent/skills.

supported.guidance: Local Hermes config.yaml selected custom provider only. Dynamic credentials, routing overrides and nonempty credential pools stop without fallback. Real-host API and delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute HERMES_HOME/skills; otherwise ~/.hermes/skills on macOS/Linux. Windows uses LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/skills, with legacy ~/.hermes only when the current root is absent.

supported.guidance: Local canonical settings.json and auth.yaml, with consistent selected provider/model/default instance. Legacy stores stop without migration. Real-host API and delivery acceptance remain pending.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute EVOX_AGENT_DIR or EVOX_CODING_AGENT_DIR plus skills; conflicting overrides stop. Otherwise ~/.evox/agent/skills.

supported.guidance: Local VS Code default profile customendpoint file only. The distributed adapter verifies one matching group whose models share supported service routes and one inline Bearer credential, without identifying chat selection. Different Keys, matching groups and unsupported overrides stop. Portable, named and remote profiles are not supported. Real-host acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: Use ~/.copilot/skills; doctor also reports documented shared ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills duplicates without deleting them.

supported.guidance: Local Octop SQLite only. Read the saved default connection, or a unique enabled matching service when no default exists, in a read-only WAL-aware transaction. No global Skill directory or current conversation selection is inferred. Real-host acceptance remains pending.
supported.directorySelection: Explicit absolute --target / -Target for the current local agent workspace's .octop/skills; never enumerate agents or use the global skill-package store. OCTOP_HOME selects only the connection root.

supported.guidance: Adapter shipped in Skills 1.0.0 for confirmed Oh My Pi local saved/file-overlay sessions. Selected profile YAML and up to four absolute PI_CONFIG_FILES overlays resolve one exact default role and inline credential. Named profiles and ordered overlays are fixture-tested. Project/session/runtime/extension overrides and dotenv scopes remain unsupported. Never reuse another profile or Pi credentials. Real-host API and native delivery acceptance pending.
supported.directorySelection: Validated PI_CONFIG_DIR name under home, default .omp; OMP_PROFILE before PI_PROFILE, with explicitly empty canonical value selecting default. Named profiles use <config>/profiles/<profile>/agent/skills and ignore PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR; default accepts its unambiguous absolute override. Dotenv scopes stop; never select ~/.pi/agent.

supported.guidance: Adapter shipped in Skills 1.0.0 for MiniMax Code CLI (mcode) local saved-default sessions only. Separate from minimax-code Desktop; never reads Desktop preferences. Profiles and session/runtime overrides are unsupported. Real-host API and delivery acceptance pending.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute MINIMAX_DATA_DIR/skills, then MAVIS_DATA_DIR/skills, otherwise ~/.minimax/skills. Switch uses client ID minimax-code for both modes; Skills must bind explicitly to minimax-code-cli for CLI.

supported.guidance: Shipped in Skills 1.0.0 with fixture coverage; real host loading, API and file delivery pending. Local saved Qwen selected auth type/model only; exact settings.env Key, bounded dotenv and system/project overlay checks. Unrepresented session overrides remain unsupported.
supported.directorySelection: QWEN_HOME/skills when absolute; otherwise ~/.qwen/skills. Shared ~/.agents/skills may shadow it.

supported.guidance: Shipped in Skills 1.0.0 with fixture coverage; real host loading, API and file delivery pending. Local models.json only. All enabled matching entries must share one supported connection and inline Key. Unrepresented session overrides remain unsupported.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR/skills; otherwise ~/.codebuddy/skills. Separate from WorkBuddy.

supported.guidance: Shipped in Skills 1.0.0 with fixture coverage; real host loading, API and file delivery pending. Local providers.json BYOK only; resolve model.provider, verify service origin and same inline Key. COPILOT_PROVIDERS_CONFIG is unsupported. Unrepresented session overrides remain unsupported.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute COPILOT_HOME/skills; otherwise ~/.copilot/skills. Shared ~/.agents/skills is also discovered.

supported.guidance: Shipped in Skills 1.0.0 with fixture coverage; real host loading, API and file delivery pending. Local settings.json customModels only. Same service entries must share one inline Key; conflicting legacy/local/project overrides stop. Unrepresented session overrides remain unsupported.
supported.directorySelection: Default ~/.factory/skills. FACTORY_HOME_OVERRIDE unsupported even with an explicit installation target.

supported.guidance: Shipped in Skills 1.0.0 with fixture coverage; real host loading, API and file delivery pending. Local saved puretokens-switch provider in one connection-bearing layer. Unrelated providers/preferences may coexist; substitutions, remote auth, plugins and managed overrides stop. Unrepresented session overrides remain unsupported.
supported.directorySelection: Absolute MIMOCODE_HOME/config/skills; otherwise XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mimocode/skills, default ~/.config/mimocode/skills.

supported.guidance: Shipped in Skills 1.0.0 with fixture coverage; real host loading, API and file delivery pending. Conditional local Codex-backed support: explicit PASEO_HOME, unique extends=codex profile and matching inherited endpoint/Key. Filtered or changed launch context stops; never read Codex auth.json. Other engines and remote daemons unsupported. Unrepresented session overrides remain unsupported.
supported.directorySelection: Local Codex-backed sessions use ~/.agents/skills. Explicit absolute PASEO_HOME selects the connection root only.
